data.name: Emulation.Emulator.race.Description
data.value: Emulates the monochrome and colour handheld consoles.

data.name: Emulation.Emulator.neocd.Description
data.value: Emulates Neo Geo CD and Neo Geo CDZ.

data.name: Emulation.Emulator.mednafen_ngp.Description
data.value: Emulates the monochrome and colour handheld consoles.

data.name: Emulation.Emulator.geolith.Description
data.value: Emulates Neo Geo cartridge and CD systems.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.Language
data.value: Select the language used by compatible games.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.DarkFilterLevel
data.value: Enable luminosity-based brightness reduction. May be used to avoid glare/eye strain when playing games with white backgrounds.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.Frameskip
data.value: Skip some video frames when performance is insufficient, to reduce interruptions in the audio output.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.FrameskipThreshold
data.value: Skip video frames when the audio buffer contains less data than this percentage of its capacity.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.RealTimeClock
data.value: Selects how the emulated real-time clock advances. 'Deterministic' counts emulated frames from a fixed base, so RTC reads are reproducible and safe for netplay, rewind and run-ahead. 'Real Time' reads the host clock directly (a live clock, but non-deterministic).

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.AudioQuality
data.value: Choose between faster sound synthesis and more accurate sound synthesis.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.AudioSampleRate
data.value: Choose the output audio sampling frequency. Higher frequencies can improve sound quality and require more processing power.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Setting.CoreProvidedAspectRatio
data.value: Display aspect ratio supplied by the emulator

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Setting.UseExternalHiscoreDat
data.value: Use the external high-score file hiscore.dat

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.SkipDisclaimer
data.value: Hide the legal notice when a game starts.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.SkipWarnings
data.value: Hide warnings about known problems when a game starts.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.DisplayMAMEMenu
data.value: Toggles the visibility of the internal MAME menu.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.Brightness
data.value: Modifies the brightness level being used.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.GammaCorrection
data.value: Modifies the gamma level being used.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.DisplayArtwork
data.value: Used to display custom artwork when available.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.ArtworkResolutionMultiplier
data.value: Increases the artwork resolution by the selected multiplier value.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.UseSamples
data.value: Allow audio sample files to be loaded when provided in the samples directory.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.SampleRateHint
data.value: Choose the output audio sampling frequency. Automatic mode uses the preferred output frequency.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.AutosaveHiscore
data.value: Recommended to use default which will save the hiscore when closing content. Recursively will save repeatedly the entire time during gameplay. Disabled will bypass the use of the hiscore.dat file entirely.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.CPUClockScale
data.value: Used to under or over clock the emulated CPU by a specified percentage.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.Use32BitsColorDepthWhenAvailable
data.value: Change pixel format, some games require this to render properly, it could impact performances on some platforms

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.UseA60HzRefreshRate
data.value: Use 60 Hz instead of the original refresh rate. This can change the game speed and cause uneven animation.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Setting.FixedFrameskip
data.value: Fixed number of video frames to skip

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.FixedFrameskip
data.value: When 'Frameskip' is set to 'Fixed', or if the frontend doesn't support the alternative 'Frameskip' mode, skip rendering at a fixed rate of X frames out of X+1

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.CPUClock
data.value: Change emulated cpu frequency for various systems, by increasing you can fix native slowdowns in some games, by decreasing you can help performance on low-end devices

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.DiagnosticInput
data.value: Configure button combination to enter cabinet service menu

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.Hiscores
data.value: Enable high scores support, you also need the file hiscore.dat in your system/fbneo/ folder

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.AllowPatchedRomsets
data.value: Allow romsets from your system/fbneo/patched/ folder to override your romsets, crcs will be ignored but sizes and names must still match, in addition this is also the master switch for whether IPS Patch and RomData are executed or not, you need to close content for this setting to take effect

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.SampleInterpolation
data.value: Configure sample interpolation, it could impact performances

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.FMInterpolation
data.value: Configure FM interpolation, it could impact performances

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.AnalogSpeed
data.value: Mitigate analog controls speed, some games might require low values to be playable

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Value.UpPriorityUpOverrideDown
data.value: Give priority to the upward direction

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Value.DownPriorityLeftRightLastInputPriority
data.value: Give priority to the downward direction; use the latest horizontal input

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.CrosshairEmulation
data.value: Choose whether to show the aiming marker. Automatic mode hides it when a light gun or touchscreen is used.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.NeoGeoMode
data.value: Load appropriate bios depending on your choice, under the condition such a bios is compatible with the running game

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Value.UseBiosSetInBIOSDipswitch
data.value: Use the BIOS selected by the hardware switches

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.MemoryCardMode
data.value: Change the behavior for the memory card

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.VFSEnabled
data.value: Use the virtual file system supplied by the application. Version 4 or later is required.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.AutomaticLoadFastForward
data.value: Experimental feature to automatically fast-forward during CD access. Works with: - Generic SCSI - Sega CD and Neo Geo CD

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.SampleRate
data.value: Number of audio samples taken per second. Higher rates provide better quality audio.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.FrameskipInterval
data.value: Maximum number of consecutive frames that may be skipped. Lower values keep visual updates smoother at the cost of more audio drops when the host is overloaded.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.ShowGameInformation
data.value: Show MAME's driver-status and game-information screens at startup before the game begins running.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.Stereo
data.value: Output stereo audio. Disable for slightly lower CPU on games that don't use stereo mixing.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.SystemType
data.value: Specify the System Type: AES, MVS, or Universe BIOS System

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.CDSystemType
data.value: Specify the CD System Type when loading Neo Geo CD disc images

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.Region
data.value: Specify the Region: USA, Japan, Asia, Europe

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.MemoryCard
data.value: Enable or Disable the Memory Card

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Setting.MemoryCardWriteProtect
data.value: Protect the memory card against changes

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.MemoryCardWriteProtect
data.value: Prevent changes to the memory card.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.SettingMode
data.value: Bring up the System ROM menu at boot on arcade systems

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.FourPlayerMode
data.value: Set Four Player (dual MVS cabinet) mode for Asia/Japan MVS systems

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.Freeplay
data.value: Play MVS games without the need to insert coins

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Setting.MaskOverscanTop
data.value: Hide pixels along the top screen edge

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.MaskOverscanTop
data.value: Mask off pixels hidden by a bezel or border on original CRTs (top)

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Setting.MaskOverscanBottom
data.value: Hide pixels along the bottom screen edge

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.MaskOverscanBottom
data.value: Mask off pixels hidden by a bezel or border on original CRTs (bottom)

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Setting.MaskOverscanLeft
data.value: Hide pixels along the left screen edge

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.MaskOverscanLeft
data.value: Mask off pixels hidden by a bezel or border on original CRTs (left)

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Setting.MaskOverscanRight
data.value: Hide pixels along the right screen edge

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.MaskOverscanRight
data.value: Mask off pixels hidden by a bezel or border on original CRTs (right)

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Value.OstensiblyAccurateNTSCAspectRatio4544PAR
data.value: Ostensibly Accurate NTSC Aspect Ratio (45:44 PAR)

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Value.VeryTraditionalNTSCAspectRatio43DAR
data.value: Very Traditional NTSC Aspect Ratio (4:3 DAR)

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.SpritesPerLineLimit
data.value: Set the sprites-per-line limit - increasing causes glitches in some games

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.ProcessorSpeed
data.value: Run the processor at 24 MHz. This speed can cause errors in games.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.DisableADPCMAccumulatorWrap
data.value: Change the ADPCM accumulator behaviour to correct sound errors in some games. Leave this setting disabled for other games.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.CDSpeedHack
data.value: Patch BIOS busy-wait loops to reduce loading times (Does not work for Universe BIOS)

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Setting.CDDMALengthLimit
data.value: Limit the size of disc data transfers

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Help.CDDMALengthLimit
data.value: Correct the BIOS upload pointers when a CD buffer DMA is larger than one sector, fixing corrupted sound in Art of Fighting's bonus stage. This is a hack, and real hardware behaviour is unconfirmed.

data.name: Emulation.Snk.Setting.HorizontalOverscan
data.value: Hide pixels along the left and right screen edges
